scenarios.scenario-1: A module with verification, test files and a declared command traces end to end: module line, verification (priority/status), test files with existence and line counts, command provenance [verification], phases and dependents; exit 0.
scenarios.scenario-2: Missing verification ref, missing verification file, missing test file and missing module PATH are errors (exit 1) with stable codes; a browsable partial chain still renders.
scenarios.scenario-3: A verification id (V-M-XXX) resolves to its module; JSON mode returns the ADR-8 envelope with the documented data shape.

required-log-markers.marker-1: CLI text/JSON output is asserted by the tests; library paths emit no runtime log markers.

notes.note-1: Covered by test/grace-trace.test.ts (command/gap matrix, provenance sources, dependents closure, exit codes, JSON envelope).
notes.note-2: Finding codes: MISSING_VERIFICATION_REF, VERIFICATION_FILE_MISSING, TEST_FILE_MISSING, MODULE_PATH_MISSING, MODULE_FILE_MISSING, XML_INVALID (errors); NO_DECLARED_COMMAND, NO_REQUIREMENT_LINK, NO_PHASE_LINK (info).
notes.note-3: CLI surface: mygrace trace <ID> [--module M-XXX] [--path .] [--format text|json].
